full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white security-camera frame looks steeply down into a narrow nighttime service alley where three people are crossing an uneven paved surface. The upper left fades toward a dark street with tiny distant points of light. Along the left edge, a large pale rectangular panel stands beside a partly visible wheel, its bright face breaking the otherwise dark corner. The pavement opens through the center in overlapping rectangular slabs, scattered with small light flecks and several irregular seams. At the far end, a small figure with a bright head or cap stands near the left side of the passage. The posture is slightly bent, with one arm angled outward and the legs separated. Near the center, another person in a dark top and lighter trousers moves toward the camera. The head is lowered or obscured by the camera's limited detail; the hands stay close to the body. In the lower center, a third dark-clad figure is seen mostly from behind. One leg steps across the other, and a long shadow spreads down toward the bottom edge. On the right, the high wall is crowded with indistinct markings and a dark doorway. A row of boxlike containers stands along it, leading the eye from the bright upper wall into the deeper foreground. A larger open-topped bin occupies the lower right, its inner rectangle almost black. The lighting comes chiefly from a harsh fixture above the right wall, blowing that area toward white and casting enlarged black shadows across the gray ground. Details soften toward the corners, where lens falloff and grain darken the frame. The image has compressed contrast, blurred faces, and noisy low-light texture rather than clean photographic sharpness. No lettering in the wall markings is legible. The overall composition uses the steep viewpoint, bright wall, and isolated moving silhouettes to create the detached, uneasy feeling of recorded surveillance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白监控画面从陡峭的高处俯看狭窄的夜间后巷，三个人正穿过不平整的铺地。左上方渐渐没入黑暗街道，只留下远处几粒细小亮点。沿左侧边缘，一块巨大的浅色矩形板立在部分可见的车轮旁，明亮表面打破了原本幽暗的角落。地面在中央展开为相互交叠的矩形板块，散落着细小亮屑与几道不规则接缝。远端通道左侧，一名头部或帽子发亮的小人物站在那里，身体略弯，一条手臂向外斜伸，双腿分开。中央附近，另一个穿深色上衣、浅色长裤的人朝摄像头方向走来。头部低垂，或被摄像画面的有限细节遮蔽；双手靠近身体。下部中央，第三个穿深色衣服的人物主要以背影呈现。一条腿从另一条腿前跨过，长长的阴影向底边伸展。右侧高墙布满无法辨认的痕迹和一道深色门口。一列箱形容器靠墙排开，引导目光从上方发亮的墙面进入更深的前景。右下角有一只更大的敞口箱，内部矩形几乎漆黑。光线主要来自右侧墙上方的强烈灯源，把那一带冲成近白色，并在灰色地面上投下放大的黑影。画面向角落变软，镜头暗角和颗粒使边缘变黑。图像带有压缩的反差、模糊面孔与嘈杂的低照度肌理，而非干净的摄影锐度。墙上痕迹没有可辨认文字。整体构图借陡峭视角、明亮墙体与孤立的移动剪影，形成监控记录所特有的疏离和不安感。
style_prompt_en: The surveillance-style monochrome image has a fixed high viewpoint, limited tonal range, and rough low-light video texture. Pale grays are pushed nearly to white around concentrated light sources, while corners and recesses fall abruptly into black. Visible grain, blur, and compression-like smearing soften small details without erasing the strong shapes. Hard overhead illumination makes shadows stretch across broad flat surfaces, turning moving forms into stark silhouettes. Wide-angle distortion bends the edges slightly and gives the central ground plane a receding, exposed quality. Large bright rectangles and narrow dark passages organize the frame more strongly than fine outlines or color. The composition feels incidental and unposed, with much of the image given to empty circulation space and peripheral objects. The overall effect is distant, anonymous, and tense, using technical imperfections as part of its visual character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种监控式黑白图像具有固定的高位视点、有限的明度范围和粗糙的低照度视频肌理。集中光源周围的浅灰被推近白色，角落与凹处则骤然陷入黑色。可见颗粒、模糊和类似压缩拖影的痕迹柔化小细节，却不抹去有力的大形。强硬的顶光让阴影在宽阔平面上延伸，使移动形体变成鲜明剪影。广角畸变让边缘略微弯曲，也使中央平面显得向后退远而无遮掩。大片亮矩形和狭窄暗通道比精细轮廓或色彩更有力地组织画面。构图显得偶然、未经摆拍，大部分面积留给空旷的通行空间与边缘物件。整体效果疏远、匿名而紧张，技术缺陷成为视觉性格的一部分。
theme_en: High-angle black-and-white security-camera view of three people in a nighttime alley
theme_zh: 夜间小巷中三人的黑白监控俯视画面
name: Footage from CCTV
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
